scripts.setup: npm --prefix frontend ci && npm --prefix integrations/superhuman ci
scripts.dev:backend: uv run --project backend --env-file backend/.env python -m uvicorn hackathon_backend.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.check:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run test && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.check:backend: uv run --project backend --frozen --extra dev ruff check backend && uv run --project backend --frozen --extra dev pytest backend/tests
scripts.check: npm run check:frontend && npm run check:backend && npm run check:connector
